key_insight: MM-KG turns multimodal patient data and biomedical knowledge into one explicit, query-aware graph so clinical LLMs can trace which evidence supports an answer.
clinical_relevance: This could help clinical AI systems answer complex questions more reliably by separating patient evidence from background knowledge and showing which links actually matter.
method: Harmonize EHR text, imaging, genomics, and biospecimens into typed observations
Map observations to UMLS concepts and align them to a biomedical knowledge graph with explicit edges
Retrieve a compact, query-conditioned subgraph for use by an LLM or graph neural network
evidence_signal: In MIMIC-IV and ADNI experiments, combining patient evidence with biomedical knowledge improved interaction performance, with +0.194 AUROC on MIMIC and +0.299 on ADNI for questions needing both sources.
watch_item: The approach depends on accurate mapping and retrieval; if the key relation is missed or misaligned, the benefit can drop back to baseline.
paper_title: Aligning Multimodal Patient Evidence with Biomedical Knowledge Graphs for Clinical LLMs
